mechanism_narrative: A sustained 6-month decline in FEDFUNDS below 2% signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward crossing of FEDFUNDS above 2.0% signals a tightening monetary policy cycle, raising borrowing costs and reducing corporate profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the FEDFUNDS does not cross above 2.0% or 20-day returns remain non-negative despite the signal.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in FEDFUNDS below 2% and rise in GDPC1 above 16,861.6 (from t-5mo) for two consecutive months indicates dual easing, lowering discount rates and boosting demand, leading to positive 60-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: If the combined effect does not result in positive 60-day returns or if one proxy moves without the other.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in UNRATE below 4.5% from above signals labor market strengthening, boosting consumer confidence and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE does not cross below 4.5% or 5-day forward returns remain non-positive.

mechanism_narrative: Rising UNRATE below 4.5% AND PAYEMS exceeding 146,135 (from t-1mo) for two months indicates labor market expansion, enhancing corporate growth prospects and driving positive 60-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: If the combined effect does not produce positive returns over 60 days or if one moves without the other.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained monthly increases in GDPC1 above 16,861.6 (from t-5mo) for three months indicate robust demand growth, elevating equity valuations and generating positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 does not rise sufficiently or returns are not positive.

mechanism_narrative: GDPC1 exceeds INDPRO by 5% month-over-month for two consecutive months signals demand outpacing supply, driving inflationary pressures and positive 60-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: If the ratio does not exceed 5% or returns are not positive.

mechanism_narrative: INDPRO crosses above 105.0284 (t-1mo) while CPIAUCSL remains below 243.846 indicates robust supply growth without inflationary pressures, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO crosses above 105.0284 AND CPIAUCSL remains below 243.846
failure_condition: If the cross does not occur or returns are not positive despite the signal.
